findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_opportunity · Private data: get_entity, federal_register, federal_register_document, lobbying, get_theme, track_record, foreign_agents, foreign_agent_filings, form_d_raises · Public sink: track_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_opportunity · Private data: get_entity, federal_register, federal_register_document, lobbying, get_theme, track_record, foreign_agents, foreign_agent_filings, form_d_raises · Public sink: track_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
